questions.stem: A 60-year-old patient visits an Ophthalmology clinic for a Routine Eye Examination. The patient has a family history of Glaucoma, so the doctor assesses the patient's Optic Nerve head using Ophthalmoscopy and concludes that the Cup/Disc Ratio is normal. What is the Normal Cup/Disc Ratio?
